Target company: Microsoft (MSFT). Microsoft develops software and cloud services including Windows, Microsoft 365 and Azure, and operates gaming, business-software and related technology businesses.

Focal announcement: Microsoft names Jay Parikh as a member of the senior leadership team.

Decision cutoff: 2024-10-31T23:59:59-04:00. Use only information available before this cutoff.

Source: Microsoft names Jay Parikh as a member of the senior leadership team. Published date: 2024-10-31. URL: https://blogs.microsoft.com/blog/2024/10/31/microsoft-names-jay-parikh-as-a-member-of-the-senior-leadership-team.

Condensed source passage, selected from the supplied excerpt; other details are omitted: Satya Nadella, Chairman and CEO, shared the below communication with Microsoft employees this morning. With that context, I’m excited to share that Jay Parikh is joining Microsoft as a member of the senior leadership team (SLT), reporting to me. His deep connections across the start-up and VC ecosystems, coupled with his leadership roles at Akamai and Ning, will bring valuable perspective to Microsoft. As he onboards, Jay will immerse himself in learning about our company priorities and our culture and will spend time connecting with our senior leaders and meeting with customers, partners, and employees around the world. We will share more on his role and focus in the next few months.
